question: Which of the following is NOT a natural indicator for acids or bases?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Methyl orange__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Natural indicator**

 
 
• **​**A group of natural indicators that can indicate whether a compound is** basic or acidic **can be found in nature.
 
• Certain flowers, like **hydrangeas**, which are natural indicators of acids and bases, can be used to determine the** acidity or alkalinity of the soil.**
